selected_scenarios.openconfig_mdt_streaming: 4-vendor canonical OpenConfig + vendor-native streaming topology (Cisco IOS XR, Cisco IOS XE, Arista EOS, Juniper Junos).
selected_scenarios.service_provider_cisco: Cross-transport state coherence linking gNMI, SNMPv2c, Syslog, and NetFlow/IPFIX on cisco-asr9k-pe1.
selected_scenarios.cisco_aci_microburst: High-resolution QoS queue occupancy and tail-drop surge during DEGRADE.

tshark_loopback_note: On macOS unprivileged user environment, /dev/bpf0 is permission-restricted without root ChmodBPF; protocol diagnostics are captured directly via gnmic --log gRPC trace output and server gRPC diagnostics without claiming PCAP protobuf dissection.
